notes.title: Pink Screen Bug
notes.notes: I am aware of the pink screen bug that many people are encountering. However, because it doesn't happen on any computer I've been able to run the game on, it's difficult for me to troubleshoot. Just know that I am aware of this, and will continue to think about what could be causing it, and have people who are experiencing the problem assist me in fixing it. My apologies to those who are encountering this. Hopefully I can get it fixed soon.

notes.title: Don't Forget to Report Bugs!
notes.notes:
It's come to my attention that some people have been experiencing bugs. Of course, I wish to get these fixed as soon as I can, but need as much information on them as possible.

If you experience anything that seems out of place/like it's not supposed to happen, or is a blatant bug, please report it to me via email at: [b]sbpfeedback@gmail.com[/b]. Remember to be as specific as possible (what were you doing/what was going on when the problem occurred? Are you able to reproduce it? If so, how?)

I apologize for these bugs, I know they can be very annoying, especially when they hinder/wipe out your progress. As previously mentioned, I wish to get them all fixed as soon as I can, I just need a little help from the community if I'm to tackle them all.

I do my best to create a clean, bug-free experience, so if you guys could help me out a little with some feedback as to where these bugs lie and if/how they can be reproduced or tracked down, I'd very much appreciate it. Again, I apologize. Please bear with me!
